title: Explicit finite-stage dual-to-Hom comparisons and their components
statement: For a finite-field datum D, prime l distinct from its characteristic, an independently sized algebraic closure Ω of Padic l, and a separated finite-type scheme X over Spec D.k, use the Duality record of def-sf-common-stage-verdier-data and the actual internal Hom of def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom. Construct HomComparison.localComparison E as the natural isomorphism from inclusion(E).op followed by B.duality.dual to inclusion(E).op followed by homDual(B.omega). Invert B.comparison E, include the finite HomIdentification.duality, compare finite and common-stage internal Hom using the actual scalar self unitor, and map B.omegaComparison E in the second Hom variable. Define HomComparison.component B K by evaluation at the literal stage K.stage and object K.obj. These are concrete isomorphisms and are natural for every arrow included from a single finite stage; no scalar-extension naturality is included in this definition.

proof.text: The common-stage internal-Hom representative formula gives homToStage_naturality after factoring its output representative through isoToStage and cancelling the target comparison. Apply this at E itself: the compositum E with E lies in E. Remove both repeated-stage transitions with the actual scalar unitor, obtaining the natural isomorphism stageHomInclusion.

Finite HomIdentification supplies closure on all pairs and a natural finite dual-to-Hom comparison. Compose its included isomorphism with stageHomInclusion, the inverse B.comparison, and internal-Hom postcomposition with B.omegaComparison. Functoriality proves naturality of the last factor. Evaluate this natural isomorphism at K.stage and K.obj. Naturality at an included finite-stage arrow is the naturality of that same isomorphism.

def component (B : Duality D l hl Ω X)
    (K : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω X) :
    B.duality.dual.obj (op K) ≅
      (homDual l Ω X B.omega (fun K ↦ allPairs l Ω X D hl B.finite K B.omega)).obj
        (op K)
